methodology.title: How scores are calculated
methodology.description: How Ratable calculates scores: verified reviews only, a minimum per criterion, and no influence from payment.
methodology.heading: How scores are calculated
methodology.intro: A Ratable score is simple and public. These are the rules.

items.title: Verified reviews only
items.text: Only reviews from people who proved their visit or purchase count. An unverified review is shown with a clear label and never changes the score.

items.title: Every review weighs the same
items.text: The overall score is the average of the verified reviews' scores. One review's score is the average of the criteria its author answered.

items.title: A minimum per criterion
items.text: A criterion's score appears only after at least 5 verified answers, so it never rests on one opinion.

items.title: One review per account
items.text: Each account has one review per place. Every edit is saved in a dated history, and a deleted review is hidden while its history is kept.

items.title: No paid influence
items.text: Nothing a business pays for changes a score, a ranking or removes a review.

items.title: Protected identity
items.text: If a reviewer chooses to be anonymous, their name never appears anywhere.

methodologyVerification.title: How reviews are verified
methodologyVerification.description: How Ratable checks that a reviewer visited the place or bought the product, and what happens to their documents.
methodologyVerification.heading: How reviews are verified
methodologyVerification.intro: A verified review is the only kind that counts toward a score. This is how we check it.

items.title: Proof of a visit or purchase
items.text: The reviewer uploads a document that fits the category, such as a lease, an invoice or a booking confirmation. The accepted types differ by category.

items.title: Automatic check, then a person
items.text: We read the document automatically to confirm its type, the place name and its date, and we detect duplicate files. Anything doubtful goes to a human reviewer, and a random sample of accepted proofs is checked too.

items.title: Nobody sees the documents
items.text: Documents are kept in private storage and are never shown to any user or business. We only record the proof type, date, result and a one-way fingerprint.

items.title: Deleted after the decision
items.text: We delete the file after the decision unless the reviewer chose to keep it, with a separate consent and for a limited time. They can delete it at any time.

items.title: Phone verification does not change the score
items.text: Verifying a phone number speeds up publishing, but it does not make a review verified. Only proof does.

items.title: Unverified is clearly labelled
items.text: An unverified review is shown with a clear label and never counts toward a score or a ranking.

methodologyModeration.title: Moderation and trust rules
methodologyModeration.description: How Ratable moderates reviews and comments, how identity is protected, and why nobody can buy the removal of a review.
methodologyModeration.heading: Moderation and trust rules
methodologyModeration.intro: We check what is posted before it appears. These are the rules.

items.title: Every review is checked before it appears
items.text: Our tools check the text automatically. A review that passes and has proof, or comes from an account with a verified phone, is published; anything doubtful goes to a human reviewer.

items.title: Reviews of people are always read by a person
items.text: Reviews about individuals, such as teachers or service providers, are always read by a human reviewer before publishing.

items.title: A clear reason when something is hidden
items.text: If a review is hidden, its author sees why and can edit it so that it is checked again.

items.title: Reports and disputes
items.text: Any reader can report content that breaks the rules, and a business owner can dispute a review. A human reviewer decides and the decision is logged.

items.title: No buying removal or rank
items.text: Payment never changes a score or a ranking and never removes a review. Subscriptions buy tools and analytics only.

items.title: Anonymous reviewers are protected
items.text: Moderators cannot see who wrote an anonymous review, and the name never appears in pages, logs or search results. It can be looked up only by an administrator, with a written reason, and every look-up is logged.
